_golden.written_with: a scratch script applying the contract's rules by hand; no kit or pack code ran
_golden.type: what the grid shows at rev 20, rev 28 and rev 29: the check values for a mock
notes: built from the keyed state plus the numbering rule plus derived A1 text, merges and style hints, nothing else
a formula cell shows its A1 text; its result is the file's cached value, shown as 'as last calculated', or none ('not calculated') for a formula written live
style is the hint of the cell's style index, left out when it is the default (not bold, no fill, General)
blank_rows are rows with no element: drawn empty, with their numbers
rev 29 follows the outside save: every result recalculated by the app, and a second merge
